sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Naptime unlocked. Ultimate (Naptime) is available from Mystic Burst.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Pillow Toss (1 to 2).

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Nova, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 32000 souls (~32.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 31200 souls (~31.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healing Nova, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Pillow Toss's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Pillow Toss (144) clears its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 28.8 to Pillow Toss's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-24,000 (levels 12-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Tag Along T3, Naptime T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pillow Toss, damage) grows from 165 to 268. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Healing Nova.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Tag Along: takes 18% off its 32s base cooldown.

items.name: Healing Nova
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Pillow Toss (2 to 3). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | Imbued on Naptime: widens its range.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Tag Along: resets its 32s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On Tag Along. When your nap ends, use it to jump straight back on.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-43,200 (levels 27-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lil Helpers T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pillow Toss, damage) grows from 268 to 363. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Heroic Aura.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Self-cast it while napping and it lands on your mate.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Pillow Toss (284) clears its 165-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 3 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 195s; 20% off is 39s per full rotation.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Naptime radius (22m), Lil Helpers aura radius (10m), Lil Helpers aura soft radius (10m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Pillow Toss's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healing Nova? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Trophy Collector.
sections.desc: Dying after Healing Nova? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Trophy Collector.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Tag Along (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns that stop your ult or knock you off Tag Along.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Self-cast it while napping: it lands on your mate and lasts longer. Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.why: contradiction: Naptime deals no damage, so a trigger on ultimate damage never fires.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 195s of base cooldown across your kit, 145s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..

sections.label: Optional swap / pivot
sections.legacy_desc: Get Heroic Aura right after Healing Nova, then carry on.
sections.desc: Get Heroic Aura right after Healing Nova, then carry on.
